arxiv-2106-00459.title: KGPool: Dynamic Knowledge Graph Context Selection for Relation Extraction
arxiv-2106-00459.creator: Abhishek Nadgeri 1,2 , Anson Bastos 1,3 , Kuldeep Singh 1,5 , Isaiah Onando Mulang’ 1,7 Johannes Hoffart 6 , Saeedeh Shekarpour 4 , and Vijay Saraswat 6 1 Zerotha Research, 2 RWTH Aachen, 3 IIT Hyderabad, 4 University of Dayton 5 Cerence GmbH, 6 Goldman Sachs, 7 IBM Research, Africa abhishek.nadgeri
arxiv-2106-00459.description: Abstract We present a novel method for relation extraction (RE) from a single sentence, mapping the sentence and two given entities to a canonical fact in a knowledge graph (KG). Especially in this presumed sentential RE setting, the context of a single sentence is often sparse.

arxiv-2110-13326.title: Highly nonlinear dipolar exciton-polaritons in bilayer MoS 2
arxiv-2110-13326.creator: Biswajit Datta, Mandeep Khatoniar, Prathmesh Deshmukh, Félix Thouin, Rezlind Bushati, Simone De Liberato, Stephane Kena Cohen, Vinod M. Menon
arxiv-2110-13326.description: Abstract Realizing nonlinear optical response in the low photon density limit in solid-state systems has been a long-standing challenge. Semiconductor microcavities in the strong coupling regime hosting exciton-polaritons have emerged as attractive candidates in this context. However, the weak interaction between these quasiparticles has been a hurdle in this quest.

arxiv-2303-02090.title: Parallel-in-Time Solver for the All-at-Once Runge–Kutta Discretization
arxiv-2303-02090.creator: Santolo Leveque, Luca Bergamaschi, Ángeles Martínez, John W. Pearson
arxiv-2303-02090.description: Abstract In this article, we derive fast and robust parallel-in-time preconditioned iterative methods for the all-at-once linear systems arising upon discretization of time-dependent PDEs. The discretization we employ is based on a Runge–Kutta method in time, for which the development of parallel solvers is an emerging research area in the literature of numerical methods for time-dependent PDEs.

arxiv-2405-16586.title: Three-edge-coloring projective planar cubic graphs: A generalization of the Four Color Theorem
arxiv-2405-16586.creator: Yuta Inoue, Ken-ichi Kawarabayashi, Atsuyuki Miyashita, Bojan Mohar, Tomohiro Sonobe
arxiv-2405-16586.description: Abstract We prove that every cyclically 4-edge-connected cubic graph that can be embedded in the projective plane, with the single exception of the Petersen graph, is 3-edge-colorable. In other words, the only (non-trivial) snark that can be embedded in the projective plane is the Petersen graph.

arxiv-2409-17017.title: Uncertainty quantification in flow cytometry using a cell sorter
arxiv-2409-17017.creator: Amudhan Krishnaswamy-Usha, Gregory A. Cooksey, Paul Patrone
arxiv-2409-17017.description: Abstract In cytometry, it is difficult to disentangle the contributions of population variance and instrument noise towards total measured variation. Fundamentally, this is due to the fact that one cannot measure the same particle multiple times. We propose a simple experiment that uses a cell sorter to distinguish instrument-specific variation.

arxiv-2504-16937.title: A Framework for the Assurance of AI-Enabled Systems
arxiv-2504-16937.creator: Ariel S. Kapusta, David Jin, Peter M. Teague, Robert A. Houston, Jonathan B. Elliott, Grace Y. Park, Shelby S. Holdren
arxiv-2504-16937.description: Abstract The United States Department of Defense (DOD) looks to accelerate the development and deployment of AI capabilities across a wide spectrum of defense applications to maintain strategic advantages. However, many common features of AI algorithms that make them powerful, such as capacity for learning, large-scale data ingestion, and problem-solving, raise new technical, security, and ethical challenges.

arxiv-2506-08442.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Shigang Quan, Hailong Tan, Shui Liu, Zhenzhe Zheng, Ruihao Zhu, Liangyue Li, Quan Lu, Fan Wu. Online Travel Platforms (OTPs) have been working on improving their hotel Search & Ranking (S&R) systems that facilitate efficient matching between consumers and hotels. Existing OTPs focus almost exclusively on improving platform revenue.

There are however few published studies which assess the efficacy and safety of HCV therapy in children. A systematic review of the literature was completed f

pmc-10535312.title: Attosecond-Level Delay Sensing via Temporal Quantum Erasing
pmc-10535312.creator: Fabrizio Sgobba, Andrea Andrisani, Stefano Dello Russo, Mario Siciliani de Cumis, Luigi Santamaria Amato, Francesco De Leonardis
pmc-10535312.description: Traditional Hong-Ou-Mandel (HOM) interferometry, insensitive to photons phase mismatch, proved to be a rugged single-photon interferometric technique. By introducing a post-beam splitter polarization-dependent delay, it is possible to recover phase-sensitive fringes, obtaining a temporal quantum eraser that maintains the ruggedness of the original HOM with enhanced sensitivity.

pmc-10599501.title: Atopic dermatitis and cognitive dysfunction in middle-aged and older adults: A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-10599501.creator: Qi Zhou, Dejiang Yang, Chongyu Xiong, Xinming Li, Shuo-Yan Gau, Shuo-Yan Gau, Shuo-Yan Gau, Shuo-Yan Gau
pmc-10599501.description: BackgroundAtopic dermatitis (AD) is a common chronic inflammatory skin disease that affects adults worldwide. Recent evidence suggests that AD may be associated with cognitive dysfunction, but the results of individual studies have been inconsistent. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to evaluate the association between AD and cognitive dysfunction in middle-aged and older adults.

pmc-10696888.title: Nanotechnology in leukemia: diagnosis, efficient-targeted drug delivery, and clinical trials
pmc-10696888.creator: Maha M Salama, Nora M Aborehab, Nihal M El Mahdy, Ahmed Zayed, Shahira M Ezzat
pmc-10696888.description: Leukemia is a group of malignant disorders which affect the blood and blood-forming tissues in the bone marrow, lymphatic system, and spleen. Many types of leukemia exist; thus, their diagnosis and treatment are somewhat complicated. The use of conventional strategies for treatment such as chemotherapy and radiotherapy may develop many side effects and toxicity.

pmc-10707269.title: Ligand Recognition by the Macrophage Galactose-Type C-Type Lectin: Self or Non-Self?—A Way to Trick the Host’s Immune System
pmc-10707269.creator: Justyna Szczykutowicz
pmc-10707269.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). The cells and numerous macromolecules of living organisms carry an array of simple and complex carbohydrates on their surface, which may be recognized by many types of proteins, including lectins. Human macrophage galactose-type lectin (MGL, also known as hMGL/CLEC10A/CD301) is a C-type lectin receptor expressed on professional antigen-presenting cells (APCs) specific to glycans containing terminal GalNAc residue, such as Tn antigen or LacdiNAc but also sialylated Tn antigens. Macrophage galactose-type lectin (MGL) exhibits immunosuppressive properties, thus facilitating the maintenance of immune homeostasis.

pmc-11353830.title: Activation of the CDK7 Gene, Coding for the Catalytic Subunit of the Cyclin-Dependent Kinase (CDK)-Activating Kinase (CAK) and General Transcription Factor II H, by the Trans-Activator Protein Tax of Human T-Cell Leukemia Virus Type-1
pmc-11353830.creator: Mashiro Shirasawa, Rinka Nakajima, Yaxuan Zhou, Lin Zhao, Mariana Fikriyanti, Ritsuko Iwanaga, Andrew P. Bradford, Kenta Kurayoshi, Keigo Araki, Kiyoshi Ohtani
pmc-11353830.description: Human T-cell leukemia virus type-1 (HTLV-1) is the etiological agent of adult T-cell leukemia (ATL). The trans-activator protein Tax of HTLV-1 plays crucial roles in leukemogenesis by promoting proliferation of virus-infected cells through activation of growth-promoting genes. However, critical target genes are yet to be elucidated.

pmc-11634874.title: Urethra-preserving and dorsal capsule fenestration with robot-assisted simple prostatectomy for severe LUTS in small prostate: a case report
pmc-11634874.creator: Lijie Wen, Yue Zhang, Yi He, Yang Yu, Bo Yang
pmc-11634874.description: BackgroundSmall prostates (volume <30 ml) induce bladder outlet obstruction with pathophysiological changes distinct from those associated with large prostates. Treatment options often include transurethral incision of the prostate (TUIP) or transurethral resection of the prostate (TURP). Existing treatments have issues with high recurrence and complication rates.

pmc-11641513.title: The Effectiveness of eHealth Interventions in Promoting the Health Literacy of Informal Caregivers: A Systematic Literature Review Protocol
pmc-11641513.creator: Patrícia Valentim, Paulo Costa, Adriana Henriques, Paulo Nogueira, Andreia Costa
pmc-11641513.description: Background: Digital Information and Communication Technologies (ICTs) offer significant opportunities to enhance public health, particularly through their strategic use in promoting health literacy. Objectives: This systematic review protocol aims to outline the methodological steps necessary to conduct a systematic review of the effectiveness of digital interventions in improving health literacy among informal caregivers.

pmc-11845353.title: Robotic myxoma resection using an ultrasonic aspirator system
pmc-11845353.creator: Yoshitsugu Nakamura, Miho Kuroda, Yuto Yasumoto, Taisuke Nakayama
pmc-11845353.description: ce.1, 2, 3 Left atrial myxomas can be seen directly through right-side left atriotomy, but because myxomas are gelatinous and friable, they are easily damaged during surgical manipulation, potentially causing embolism or metastasis in the pulmonary veins or left ventricle. Therefore, resection of the tumor and its attachment to the endocardium as a single mass is recommended.

pmc-12430435.title: Integrating Knowledge-Based and Machine Learning for Betel Palm Mapping on Hainan Island Using Sentinel-1/2 and Google Earth Engine
pmc-12430435.creator: Hongxia Luo, Shengpei Dai, Yingying Hu, Qian Zheng, Xuan Yu, Bangqian Chen, Yuping Li, Chunxiao Wang, Hailiang Li, Vasileios Liakos
pmc-12430435.description: The betel palm is a critical economic crop on Hainan Island. Accurate and timely maps of betel palms are fundamental for the industry’s management and ecological environment evaluation. To date, mapping the spatial distribution of betel palms across a large regional scale remains a significant challenge.

pmc-13314833.title: The Immediate Impact of Infarct Size on the Systemic Inflammatory Response: IL-6 as Central Mediator Identified through Biomarker and Proteomic Profiling
pmc-13314833.creator: Jonathan Los, Frans B Mensink, Özlem Bulut, Ilse H Hol, Aysun Cetinyurek-Yavuz, Niels P Riksen, Saloua El Messaoudi, Jan H Cornel, Robert-Jan M van Geuns
pmc-13314833.description: Myocardial infarction (MI) induces an inflammatory response that may be amenable to targeted therapy. This cohort study evaluated the systemic inflammatory burden across different infarct sizes using serial measurements of C-reactive protein (CRP), interleukin-6 (IL-6), and targeted inflammatory proteomics (Olink’s Target 96 Inflammation panel) during hospitalization and up to 12 weeks post-MI.

pmc-13559216.title: The E2 ubiquitin‐conjugating enzymes OsUBC11 and OsUBC12 promote rice seed germination by ubiquitinating and destabilizing OsABI3 in the ABA signaling pathway
pmc-13559216.creator: Tian‐Ci Xie, Tao Qing, Chuang Yang, Jia‐Mu Wang, Hai‐Ping Lu, Jian‐Xiang Liu
pmc-13559216.description: SUMMARYThe ubiquitin‐conjugating enzymes (E2) play critical roles in plant stress responses and development, but their functions in ABA‐mediated seed germination in rice remain largely unknown. We identified two homologous E2 enzymes, OsUBC11 and OsUBC12, which are highly expressed in rice seeds and induced by multiple abiotic stresses including salt, osmotic stress, and ABA treatment.

pmc-13579715.title: Inherited bone marrow failure with ERCC6L2 gene mutation: presentation of aplastic anemia in a 3-year-old child: a case report
pmc-13579715.creator: Anteneh Girma Mengistu, Yared Shiferaw Heyi, Nathanael Elias Temesgen, Selamawit Kassahun Aweke, Natnael Mathewos Assale, Hiwote Molla Tsega, Merahi kefyalew Merahi
pmc-13579715.description: BackgroundAplastic anemia is a rare hematologic disorder characterized by bone marrow hypoplasia and peripheral pancytopenia. While most pediatric cases are acquired, inherited bone marrow failure syndromes (IBMFS) are important differential diagnoses. ERCC6L2-associated IBMFS is a newly recognized and rare condition with significant implications for diagnosis and long-term care in hematology.
